name: maxr-teamspace
description: MAXR Teamspace - Modular Staff Management Platform

scripts.dev:all: npm run docker:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@maxr/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@maxr/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@maxr/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@maxr/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@maxr/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run db:migrate --workspace=@maxr/api
